protocol: §A.1 asks for LLM sense labels with 10% manual verification; see notes/deviations.md D1

error_causes: indicator that is an inflection of the target word and shares its ambiguity (matches, palms, springs, tanks, bats, pupils, scales, pitchers, ports, cellular)

over-generic indicator that co-occurs with both senses (container/terminal for port, output/operations for plant, harbor/ice/ocean for seal, measurement/readings for scale, hello/fans/stadium for wave)
proper nouns derived from the word (Palm Beach, Seal Beach) which belong to neither sense
examples: cell|B labelled from 'cellular' on a passage about cell walls in bacteria
java|B labelled from 'beans' on a passage about Spring @Beans in Java code
port|A labelled from 'container' on a passage about IP port numbers
tank|B labelled from 'tanks' on a passage about refilling a 20lb propane tank
